title: Clawd X Digest
summary: 🤖 AI Models & Developer Workflows: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3 open weights and technical report, xAI rolls out Grok 4.5 globally, and new MCP integrations bridge Xcode and Unity directly into agent workflows.
📈 Market Dynamics & Industry Shifts: SpaceX shares navigate macro revaluations amid international competition, S&P 500 swings on tech earnings outlook, and crypto advocates lobby for the CLARITY Act.

🌍 Global Media & Engineering Culture: Emotional sports milestones highlight international competitions, open-source Apple design systems empower AI UI design, and viral creative media captures audience engagement.

items.title: @Kimi_Moonshot: Kimi K3 MoE Model Release
items.body: Moonshot AI releases open weights and technical report for Kimi K3, a 2.8T parameter MoE architecture featuring native visual understanding and multi-step reasoning.

items.title: @grok: Grok 4.5 Global Availability
items.body: xAI completes global rollout of Grok 4.5 across web, X native integration, and mobile applications as their flagship multimodal engine.

items.title: @theo: Claude Code & Codex Fast Mode Benchmark
items.body: Developer benchmark analysis compares Claude Code and Codex fast execution modes, examining 1M token context windows for low-latency agentic programming.

items.title: @unity: Unity Terminal CLI & Agent Tooling
items.body: Unity unveils a native CLI and MCP server for connecting AI coding agents, CI/CD automation pipelines, and engine workflows directly from the terminal.

items.title: @zhichaotech: Xcode MCP Integration for IDE Agents
items.body: Apple WWDC Xcode MCP protocol allows Codex and Claude agents to directly inspect project trees, build targets, and run automated unit tests within Xcode.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: SpaceX Market Valuation Adjustments
items.body: SpaceX ($SPCX) private secondary market shares adjust to $110 following macro revaluations and international aerospace progress announcements.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: S&P 500 Session Reversal
items.body: The S&P 500 index erases early session gains to trade negative as tech earnings anticipation and economic data drive intra-day market volatility.

items.title: @standwithcrypto: Senate Voting Scores on CLARITY Act
items.body: Stand With Crypto announces it will score U.S. Senate votes on the upcoming CLARITY Act on behalf of over 3 million digital asset advocates.

items.title: @LeverageETFs: SK Hynix HBM Memory Momentum
items.body: Demand for SK Hynix High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) drives semiconductor index performance as hyperscalers scale next-generation AI compute clusters.

items.title: @it_Rutie: Vozinha World Cup Reflection
items.body: Cape Verde goalkeeper Vozinha's post-match interview goes viral as fans celebrate his emotional World Cup performance and national team trajectory.

items.title: @guangGitHub: Open-Source Apple Design System Skill
items.body: Developers launch an open-source Apple Design System skill translating WWDC fluid interface principles and haptic design into re-usable agent prompts.

items.title: @SillyPointty: Mbappé Paris Announcement
items.body: Football star Kylian Mbappé draws global media attention following an Eiffel Tower proposal ahead of the new European club season.

items.title: @jarvis_best: Wes Anderson Cinema Aesthetics
